help.body:
AutoBackup watches your work folder and saves a dated copy whenever you save a file.

How to use:
1. Choose your work folder and a separate backup folder.
2. Press START and leave AutoBackup running while you work.
3. Each save creates a new dated file in the backup folder (same subfolders as your project).

Tips:
â€¢ If nothing changed since the last copy, no duplicate is made.
â€¢ Only the latest {max_versions} copies of each file are kept; older ones are removed automatically.
â€¢ Gray = stopped, Green = watching, Orange = copying.

You may see small helper files in the backup folder - leave them alone.
